title: Cloud bootstrap: Flutter SDK setup script + SessionStart hook
description: See designs/PHASE_0_PLAN.md (Cloud bootstrap). Idempotent tool/setup_cloud.sh: installs pinned Flutter SDK to $HOME/flutter if missing (version marker), flutter precache --android, optional WITH_ANDROID_SDK=1 installs Android cmdline-tools+platform+build-tools and accepts licenses; installs bd via npm and runs bd bootstrap --yes if missing. Must no-op gracefully on a dev machine that already has flutter on PATH.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh container: bash tool/setup_cloud.sh && flutter --version prints the pinned version; second run is a no-op (< 5 s). .claude/settings.json SessionStart runs setup_cloud.sh then bd prime --hook-json.
close_reason: tool/setup_cloud.sh (pinned Flutter 3.44.4, optional Android SDK, best-effort bd) + SessionStart hook

title: Phase 6 — Polish & release readiness
description: Icon/splash, accessibility pass, empty/error/loading states, local JSON backup export/import, GitHub Releases update check (port DejaPoo update_service), CI release signing, docs/INSTALL_ANDROID.md (sideload, permissions, OEM battery, SMS rate-limit ADB override), final README. See DESIGN.md Phase 6.
acceptance_criteria: Signed release APK/AAB published by CI on merge to main; MANUAL: Phase 1 device gates re-run on the release build.

title: Phase 3 — Dispatcher & background integration
description: dispatchDue() with claim/missed/grace/rate-guard/pause semantics (§2), renderMessage output snapshotted into SendLog, single-alarm re-arm, re-arm triggers (startup, reboot, time/timezone change, mutation), cross-isolate UI refresh (§3), failure notifications; replaces Phase 1 spike wiring. See DESIGN.md Phase 3.
acceptance_criteria: Fake-clock integration tests: double-fire race sends once; 3 h outage -> one missed per schedule, no burst; rate cap; pause; DST-day daily schedule; end-after-N stops; every 10 min 8AM-8PM over 48 h sends exactly 73/day with no overnight sends or missed rows; late-in-grace bodySnapshot carries scheduled-time prefix. MANUAL: 24 h device soak of a 5-min + a daily schedule with correct history.

title: Phase 5 — History, diagnostics & onboarding
description: History screen (by day, filters, failed-row detail + Retry now keeping original scheduled time), Settings Health panel (permissions, battery optimization, next armed alarm, last dispatch, dontkillmyapp link), first-run permission onboarding, log retention, Diagnostics behind developer toggle. See DESIGN.md Phase 5.
acceptance_criteria: Every failure path from Phase 3 tests is visible and explained in the UI; a fresh install reaches healthy state through onboarding alone.

title: Phase 4 — Schedules UX (MVP loop)
description: Schedule list (rule summary incl. window, next-send countdown, enable toggle, swipe delete + undo, Pause all) and editor (body, Include reminder time toggle + rendered preview + segment counter, contact picker + E.164 manual entry, recurrence presets + Custom, Daily window control, weekdays/start/end, next-5 preview, volume warning, Send test now, duplicate). See DESIGN.md Phase 4.
acceptance_criteria: New recurring schedule created in under 30 s; previewed times and rendered text equal engine/renderMessage output (widget tests incl. windowed schedule and prefix on/off); full CRUD works on device.

title: Phase 1 — Platform spike: background SMS on a real device
description: Risk-first spike: packages/sms_sender Kotlin plugin (multipart send + SENT result), android_alarm_manager_plus behind an AlarmScheduler interface + fake (alarmClock: true, rescheduleOnReboot), manifest permissions/receivers + manifest test, permission/onboarding helper, hidden Diagnostics screen with test-send and 5-min soak. See DESIGN.md Phase 1, §2, §4.
acceptance_criteria: MANUAL device gate (user) with app swiped away: (a) delayed single send arrives; (b) 5-min soak delivers >=12/12 within ±1 min, screen off 1 h; (c) pending alarm survives reboot; (d) fires under forced Doze (adb shell dumpsys deviceidle force-idle). Device model + Android version recorded in handoff. If (b) or (d) fails, stop and revisit alarm strategy.

title: Phase 2 — Domain & data layer
description: RecurrenceRule sealed types + JSON codec + RecurrenceEngine incl. DailyWindow (§1); renderMessage time prefix (§5); Drift schema v1 (Schedule, Recipient, SendLog, AppSettings) + schema dump + migration scaffold; repositories with injectable clock; volume estimator; adapted drift-flutter skill. See DESIGN.md Phase 2.
acceptance_criteria: Engine tests cover every rule kind and DST/month-end/leap/window/end-condition boundaries in >=2 time zones; window tests: daily re-anchor, inclusive end, overnight window, DST-day window, window+weekdays; renderMessage tests per §5; repository CRUD + soft delete tested; analyze/test green.

title: Phase 0 — Scaffold, tooling & CI
description: Flutter Android scaffold (com.rsh.smsscheduler), DejaPoo lints/theme/go_router shell (Schedules · History · Settings), tool/ci_version.sh, CI workflows (test, android, claude, claude-code-review), cloud bootstrap (tool/setup_cloud.sh + SessionStart hook), README/CLAUDE.md commands. Plan: designs/PHASE_0_PLAN.md. See DESIGN.md Phase 0.
acceptance_criteria: flutter analyze clean and flutter test --timeout 30s green in a cloud session; CI builds a versioned sms-scheduler-pr<N>-v<ver>.apk on the phase PR; MANUAL: user installs the APK and it opens to the themed shell.
